items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary:
After the Bhote Koshi floods, 626 bodies have been recovered and about 2400 people are still unaccounted for. Over 4450 people have been rescued, including more than 187 foreign nationals.

For the latest details, check the original update here: https://mofa.gov.np/content/1866/press-briefing-note-by-hon--minister-for/

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary:
Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, killing many and leaving others missing. So far 538 bodies have been recovered and 511 people are still unaccounted for.

See the full update here: https://mofa.gov.np/content/1864/latest-updates-on-flash-floods--28-august/

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams are working at the mudslide site in Gyirong Port, where three people have been reported killed, 558 are missing, and two villagers have been rescued as of Thursday morning. For the full details, see the original report here: https://english.news.cn/20260827/4b23217ccde940fb9f38a0fd388e2cae/c.html

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary:

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry has set up a hotline for families seeking info on foreign nationals missing or affected in the Rasuwa floods. Call or message +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 between 7am and 10pm, or see the full notice at the link above.

items.title: Nepal Police official found and missing lists
items.summary: Nepal Police keeps the main lists of people missing or found after the floods. Check them at https://udb.nepalpolice.gov.np/missing.

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu is working with local authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals hit by the floods in Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi. Check the original page here for contact numbers: https://www.indembkathmandu.gov.in.
